decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet shelf display is a core, flexible format close to the established offer and cheap to keep in the catalog.
The pegboard-back shelf display serves common hanging-product promotions and fits the existing production setup.
The standard quarter-pallet display is a staple retail format with steady demand from brand customers.
The eighth-pallet display complements the pallet-size range and costs little to maintain alongside related formats.
The wooden pallet departs from the firm's cardboard core and carries more risk, but it adds range and was only just launched.
The media-product display targets a shrinking physical-media segment, but it is close to the core offer and easy to keep.
